sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-F of JU D Unit 2019-2020 occupies book PDF pp.138-141 (printed book pp.137-140): questions pp.138-141 under 'Short Syllabus' (pp.138-139 and p.140 top), 'Extra Syllabus' (p.140 and p.141) and 'Old Syllabus' (printed Q37 only, p.141) headings, with the paper's original numbering 01-80 retained; printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') and printed worked solutions on p.141 for questions 12, 18, 24, 26, 29, 46, 48, 50 (Short Syllabus) and 78 (Extra Syllabus) — every worked-solution key agrees with the answer table; the explanation printed under no. 50, however, works out the oxidation number of Cl in ClO2-, which belongs to printed question 52 (documented in the extractionNotes of Q50 and Q52). Transcription by direct visual reading of every page with zoomed re-reads of all question pages and of the answer table; chemical/mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, plain digits for subscripts, Bengali numerals converted to Western digits).

examRules.sourceNote: Paper header (book PDF p.138) states: পূর্ণমান: ৮০ (full marks 80), ইউনিট: D, সেট: F, সময়: ৫৫ মিনিট (55 minutes); the printed instructions state 80 questions in the paper, all must be answered, 0.20 marks deducted per wrong answer, and no calculator may be used. These are transcribed from the book's paper header only and are NOT entered as a verified scoring rule.
